styleLock.direction: cool clinical ice-blue men's underwear studio commerce
styleLock.backgroundSystem: one flat controlled field per screen and never two in one: frost-white #F2F7FC seamless field for the packshot, the material screen and the empty spec grid, ice-blue #8FB6DF CG step-stage field for the benefit hero, the variant screen and the close, deep indigo-slate #2E4664 full-bleed field for the pain-point split, the macro board and the icon matrix; no scenic depth, no gradient sky, no curtain or room architecture
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool even studio light around 6000K, broad front-left softbox key with a fill card on the shadow side, low contrast, soft contact shadow that always grounds the floating garment, grazing light only inside the macro screen, no harsh speculars and no blown highlights
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte lacquered circular tiered step stage and a matching fluted column plinth, pale frost-white seamless counter board for flat lay and macro boards, matte deep indigo-slate insert board, no concrete, no wood, no fabric drape as a surface
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif as the single family, one bold two-line Chinese display headline plus one thin letter-spaced English kicker, one outlined capsule tag and one dash-flanked sub-line, headline 26-42pt, label 12-16pt, every rendered Chinese string comes from a selling_point or callout placeholder slot and never from source copy
styleLock.iconSystem: single-weight hollow thin-line icons only, drawn as outlines in #2E4664 on frost-white #F2F7FC or in #F2F7FC on deep indigo-slate #2E4664, arranged in a two-row by three-column matrix, plus empty circle outlines and four-corner framing brackets as the only graphic devices; no filled badges, no shields, no seals, no award or certification marks
styleLock.presentationRules: three locked scales only: the garment floating on an invisible form with a soft contact shadow, the garment laid flat on one plane, and the tight macro reading of one construction edge; identical front orientation and centre-weighted scale between screens, waistband kept horizontal, leg openings never clipped, the front panel kept plain and unmarked, and no screen ever mixes a flat-lay scale with a floating scale
noDrift: no palette changes outside the four locked hexes
no mixed fonts, no handwritten or serif lettering
no scenic, curtain or gradient backgrounds
no model, face, limbs or body parts in frame
no embossed badge, shield, seal or certification artwork
no invented percentages, test standards, yarn counts or sales figures
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool clinical men's underwear commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of frost-white studio field #F2F7FC, ice-blue CG step stage #8FB6DF, deep indigo-slate information field #2E4664 and one warm cotton-husk accent #A8703C; cool even studio light around 6000K with a broad front-left softbox key, fill card on the shadow side and a soft contact shadow that always grounds the garment; matte lacquered circular tiered step stage and fluted column plinth as the only set pieces; modern geometric sans-serif for every rendered line with one thin letter-spaced English kicker; single-weight hollow thin-line icons in a two-row three-column matrix, outlined capsule tags, empty circle outlines and four-corner brackets only, never filled badges or seals; garment floating on an invisible form, laid flat or shown in tight macro at a stable centre-weighted scale with the front panel left plain and unmarked; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no model, no invented certification or sales artwork.

provenance.notes: 源件为「男装/男装 (30).JPG」详情长图，已切为 11 屏逐屏读取（只读 panels，未读整图与其它源目录）。逐屏事实：第 1 屏为封面主张屏，产品悬浮于圆形阶梯台面之上，浅冰蓝棚拍场＋幕布景、竖排英文小字、一枚描边胶囊与一颗银色小球、左侧盆栽线叶、右上两行大字标题；第 2 屏为白底圆角卡上的两行三列线性图标矩阵（四叶形／爆炸星形／水波形各重复一次）＋下方深靛蓝整版场中的一组大字号销量数字；第 3 屏上半为产品悬浮、下半为白场上带棕色干壳的真实棉铃堆＋两行大标题＋描边胶囊＋破折号短注；第 4 屏为深靛蓝场主张屏，三枚空心圆圈内各一个短标签、背景叠淡色微生物线描、产品悬浮于下方、右下角一枚金色盾牌徽标；第 5 屏上半为深蓝场加金盾角标，下半为白场大标题＋胶囊＋两幅金色画框的授权证书样张（内含占位 LOGO 与满版假性细则文字）；第 6 屏为深靛蓝满版场＋白色棉铃线描图形＋四角取景框线＋两组标题胶囊，左上仍叠着上一屏证书样张、素材站水印与网址、二维码及促销导流条；第 7 屏上半为深蓝布面微距上两组大字号参数（左组百分数、右组支数，中间细竖线分隔），下半为白场两件产品并排＋底部色名胶囊；第 8 屏上半为第三个颜色的产品与色名胶囊，下半为白场产品信息四行表（品名／尺码／面料／里料，行内为成分百分比与码段）；第 9 屏为白场尺码表（四列：尺码／腰围／体重／适配外裤码，四行实测区间值）＋一条深蓝标题带；第 10、11 屏为三段竖排灰色未填充图片占位块，各配一条深蓝文字带（圆形水波图标＋标题＋右侧一至两行短注），末屏左下另叠黑底红白促销角标与二维码。全套 11 屏无任何模特、无人像、无实穿镜头，产品一律以悬浮／平铺／微距三种尺度呈现，出现蓝、绿、粉三个颜色，松紧宽腰头为灰底黑白点纹织带，正面有一枚圆形压纹徽章。品类判定（以图为准，与文件夹名「男装」不符，故改判）：L1 由男装改判为内衣家居服，L2 取男士内衣。硬证据：①第 8 屏产品信息行首项品名即写明为该类贴身内裤，第 9 屏量法列为腰围／体重／适配外裤码三项，属贴身内衣选码逻辑，既非上衣胸肩围量法也非长裤裤长臀围量法；②产品结构为短平角剪裁＋整圈松紧宽腰头＋前裆立体囊袋＋裤脚薄压边，无门襟、无口袋、无裤耳、无腰头纽扣，缺任何外穿裤装要素，故不能归男装/下装，也不属上衣、外套、套装、工作服、运动服饰，亦与鞋靴箱包无关；③卖点措辞全部围绕贴身穿体感（边缘服帖、腰头无压迫、透气亲肤类诉求并带抗菌类主张），自我定位在贴身内穿层位而非外穿层；④其选码逻辑为贴身内衣码序、只按腰围与体重区间分档（源件的具体号型与实测数值一律未写入本模版），与男装裤装按裤长臀围建立的号型体系不一致。leaf 与细则文字、素材站水印与网址、二维码、促销导流条与黑底促销角标、全部原文案原句（含主标题、副标题、胶囊标签、破折号短注与图标标签）、销量数字、抑菌率百分比与标准编号、成分百分比与纱线支数与码段数值、尺码表实测区间、幕布与盆栽道具的独特版式。原文所有数值一律改为留空空网格、空指示条或 {callout_n} #D7E5F2 的浅雾蓝双向色块且无暖色，基础圆领件为薄荷 #A9DFE1 与 #1F9E8B，水洗牛仔件为丹宁蓝加铜橙 #C0762C，毛领派克件为蜜桃杏 #F6C6A8 与珊瑚红 #D6543C 的暖调，四件色板与本件四色无一重合，且本件是唯一的深靛满版信息场。②背景台面与道具：本件固定台面为圆形阶梯台加凹槽圆柱台，道具只有真实棉铃、空线图标矩阵与四角取景框线，全场无金属球、无圆形暗角开窗、无幕布景；雾蓝件的核心元件恰恰是抛光金属球与圆形暗角开窗，牛仔件用真实混凝土与街角台阶，毛领件用晕染杏色平场与一张墨黑插屏，本件既不引入球体反光也不引入暗场单屏。③机位体系：本件走
